name: Tesseract Motion Program
description: Build exact native MotionProgram and CompositeInstruction values while preserving target order and move types and validating retained Cartesian working frames.

inputParameters.name: native_robot
inputParameters.description: Exact isolated native tesseract_robotics.planning.Robot clone from Tesseract Planner.

inputParameters.name: targets
inputParameters.description: Non-empty ordered native CartesianTarget, JointTarget, or StateTarget sequence. Target order and move types are preserved.

inputParameters.name: group_name
inputParameters.description: Exact native kinematic-group name used to resolve joint order and TCP.

inputParameters.name: tcp_frame
inputParameters.description: Optional exact native TCP link name. When omitted, the selected native group resolves its active tip.

inputParameters.name: working_frame
inputParameters.description: Exact native working-frame link name. Defaults visibly to base_link.

inputParameters.name: profile
inputParameters.description: Exact native composite program-profile name. Defaults visibly to DEFAULT.

outputParameters.name: motion_program
outputParameters.description: Exact native tesseract_robotics.planning.MotionProgram retaining the authored targets.

outputParameters.name: program
outputParameters.description: Exact native CompositeInstruction ready for Tesseract Native Plan or Tesseract RAPID.

outputParameters.name: joint_names
outputParameters.description: Native group joint order used for unnamed joint/state targets.

outputParameters.name: tcp_frame
outputParameters.description: Exact TCP link resolved by the native robot.
